subject: Superintendent Self-Evaluation Presentation
overview: Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent presented her annual self-evaluation and supporting evidence for the 2022-2023 school year across district goals and focus standards. The committee reviewed the timeline for submitting individual evaluations to compile a composite review.

items.title: Superintendent Self-Evaluation Presentation
items.summary: Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent presented her self-evaluation, detailing progress on district goals, early literacy implementation, communications, high school safety measures, and performance standards.

items.title: Evaluation Process and Timeline Review
items.summary: Committee members reviewed upcoming deadlines for individual evaluation submissions due by May 21 and scheduled subcommittee meetings to assemble the composite evaluation ahead of a June 5 presentation.
